pdf_leer_final:
This PDF Edition

This PDF reproduces, in page form, the text of the web version of the book and is generated from the same sources. It keeps the numbering of chapters, sections, figures, and activities, so it can be used alongside the web version.

The online version is free and available at {site_text}. It is worth keeping it at hand while you read: from it the tools open with one click, some can be expanded within the page itself, and it always includes the latest revision of the text.

The applications do not run inside the PDF. The Open, Open and configure, and Explore links take you to each tool on the web and require a connection; when a tool does not store its state in the URL, the example gives in writing the values to enter. The results of the examples appear right after each example, and the solutions to the exercises at the end of their chapter.

{qr}

Cross-references to other parts of the book are internal links in the PDF.
